title: euphrasia fennica f. brevidens
intro: Euphrasia fennica f. brevidens, commonly known as a type of Eyebright plant, is a perennial species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in promoting eye health and relieving eye irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Euphrasia fennica f. brevidens include reducing redness and swelling in the eyes, soothing eye irritations, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which work together to provide its medicinal benefits.
